The '''Dog''' is an enemy in '''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]].'''

==='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''===
[[File:DogNES1.png|80px]]

Introduced in [[Galesburg|Act 1-1]], Dogs are very fast enemies, either coming up from behind [[Ryu Hayabusa|Ryu]] or rushing at him from straight ahead. They can be difficult to react to thanks to their speed. However, they only deal 1 point of damage on contact, and are easily defeated in one hit by any attack.

==Trivia==
* In the original NES game, the enemy's design looks more humanoid than dog-like in being very muscular, which was kept in the SNES trilogy.
** However, in the PC Engine version, the design was changed to look exactly like a large terrier.
